applications.faqs.q: Which grit should I start with?
applications.faqs.a: Start from the workpiece material, defect depth and required finish — a coarse grade removes material fast, then step down in grits and check the surface at each stage.

applications.faqs.q: Can I mix grits in one order?
applications.faqs.a: Yes — list the grits and quantity per grade; availability and lead time come back with the offer.

pfq.oem.q: How do I request OEM packaging?
pfq.oem.a: Include your branding and packaging requirements in the enquiry. Details will be reviewed and confirmed with your quotation.

blog.chooseBacking.title: Hook & loop or PSA: choose the right backing
blog.chooseBacking.intro: The attachment system is as important as the grit. Match it to the pad before you order.
blog.chooseBacking.start.title: Start with the requirement
blog.chooseBacking.start.body: Hook & loop discs mount onto a compatible hook-faced pad and suit operations where grit is changed often. PSA discs rely on pressure-sensitive adhesive and need a clean, flat pad. The two systems are not interchangeable.
blog.chooseBacking.compat.title: Confirm compatibility
blog.chooseBacking.compat.body: Confirm pad diameter, backing type and dust-extraction layout. A non-hole disc does not connect to a hole-based extraction pattern, and open-mesh discs need a compatible pad and extraction system.
